commands.review_summary:
The PR replaces the unbounded `HEARTBEAT.md` UTF-8 read with a 16 MiB regular-file-only read and adds a regression test that checks an oversized-file heartbeat still sends.

PR surface: Source +3, Tests +51. Total +54 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main performs an unbounded whole-file read, and the proposed regression drives a 16 MiB-plus file through `runHeartbeatOnce`. This read-only review did not deliberately trigger memory exhaustion.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Both blockers are concrete implementation-and-test defects with a narrow repair path on the existing PR branch.

target.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveHeartbeatPreflight` in `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts` read the workspace `HEARTBEAT.md` with an unbounded `fs.readFile`, allowing an arbitrarily large file to be loaded into memory and processed by the heartbeat pipeline.

## Why This Change Was Made

Switch to `readRegularFile` with a 16 MiB cap so the read is bounded and rejects symlinks and non-files. This aligns with other bounded-read fixes in the repo and prevents accidental or malicious oversized heartbeat files from causing memory pressure.

## User Impact

Oversized `HEARTBEAT.md` files are now treated like missing files: the heartbeat run continues without the file content. Normal-sized heartbeat files behave exactly as before.

## Evidence

- Added `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.oversized-heartbeat-file.test.ts` with a regression test using a `16 MiB + 1` byte file and asserting the run continues.
- Local focused run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/heartbeat-runner.oversized-heartbeat-file.test.ts --run` passes (1/1 tests).
- `oxlint` clean on changed files.

## Real behavior proof

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/heartbeat-runner.oversized-heartbeat-file.test.ts --run
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.infra.config.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/heartbeat-runner.oversized-heartbeat-file.test.ts (1 test) 286ms
     ✓ treats an oversized HEARTBEAT.md like a missing file and continues the run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 9.12s
```
